# go bug in this fork opens an issue on the fork's tracker, not upstream's.

go install
env BROWSER=$GOPATH/bin/browser
go bug
exists $TMPDIR/browser
grep '^https://github.com/trendvidia/go/issues/new$' $TMPDIR/browser
! grep 'golang/go' $TMPDIR/browser

-- go.mod --
module browser

-- main.go --
package main

import (
	"net/url"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
)

func main() {
	u, err := url.Parse(os.Args[1])
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	u.RawQuery = ""
	out := filepath.Join(os.TempDir(), "browser")
	if err := os.WriteFile(out, []byte(u.String()+"\n"), 0o666); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}
